summary: BifrOSt has a system audio service (audiod) that owns the speaker and microphone, with playback queue, volume, mute and WAV recording exposed to apps through the SDK audio client. Session categories, interruptions, route-change notifications, the AVAudioEngine graph, MIDI and speech synthesis have no app-facing counterpart; the output route (speaker or headphones) is switched by the shell alone.
